svg.text: Global topics are shared by all nodes (consumer groups rebalance across them); per-node topics carry the $SERVICE_ID of their owner; per-client topics are dedicated to one APPLICATION client.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: All topic names carry an optional queue.kafka.kafka-prefix (empty by default). Client IDs / topic filters in suffixes are sanitised or SHA-256 hashed.
